name: Field Exploration in Rock Engineering
description: Geological, rock-mechanical and ground-behavior models, aerial and remote sensing in rock engineering. Geophysical methods, seismic reflection and refraction survey, seismic cross-hole and down-hole surveys for rock characterization, electrical resistivity, MASW, SASW. Field exploration: rock drilling, boring, rock-core samplers, boring methods, core-boxes, core-orientations, core logging, laboratory and field-scale tests on rocks and rock masses, ground water flow in tunnels, stresses in rocks, stress anisotropy and stress ratio, world stress map, ground stress theory. In-situ stress measurement in rocks: stress relief, compensation, USBM, door-stopper cells, flat jack, hydrofrac, strain rossette, dilatometers. Geotechnical baseline report for rock projects, ground improvement for fractured rocks.
